notes.title: You Can Now Play As a Karen!
notes.content:
So part of my new updates, I want to be adding more customer-client interactions. Right now the customers just kinda do nothing and I want them to be more involved and... more annoying!

So the first thing that came to mind was adding a Karen. Literally.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/dWOYZzBQoKTaEFZGZI/giphy.gif[/img]

I also added this sick new splash screen, and if you didn't notice, totally changed the branding and logo of the game to a neon sign instead.

I also did a number of bug fixes and soft tweaks to little things that were annoying to me, as well as slightly optimized loading of data. The boring blah blah stuff.

But the biggest thing I've been working on, is the MOBILE VERSION!! RAHH.

I have been working on a mobile build of Coffee Break that should be going live within the next few days. Unlike the PC version, it will be totally free (because nobody buys stuff on mobile) and will be super fun to play. Unfortunately you won't be able to save data across platforms, but yea, it's a pretty cool deal for me. It just feels really good on mobile!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/U8Mf8guRQz5UNfv79Z/giphy.gif[/img]

There will be a separate announcement for when that's actually out. Anyway, enjoy the Karen-ing and enjoy the other novelties in Coffee Break for the week! I'll be adding a lot more decorations this next week and EVENTUALLY will get localization done. Until next time!

notes.title: Week 4 Update!
notes.content:
Hey guys! Welcome back to another small regular update of Coffee Break! I realize I haven't been doing as many SUBSTANTIAL updates as I had planned, but there is still a bit more content in this updates. Mainly I've been working on Achievements as well as adding more decorations and characters. I didn't get to localization yet because the achievements were a lot of work, to be honest, but now that they're integrated I'll most definitely be adding more and more achievements.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/nDC0jPF/Lir.png[/img]

For this update, I added:

Content:
[list]
[*] A log cabin wall-paper
[*] New Art Deco Wallpaper
[*] A new cyber punk character named "Lir"
[*] A blue table and chair
[/list]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/eLptnWjfpoXuQAzBQ2/giphy.gif[/img]

Tweaks:
[list]
[*] Added updated logo for main menu cause I didn't like the old one
[*] A couple of hot-fixes for controller support and for multiplayer support
[/list]

Additions:

[list]
[*] Set foundation for achievements and added a few base achievements to the game.
[/list]

I definitely want to start making more substantial updates as I'm aware this is a little "lite" for a full week. That said, hopefully I've kind of now set a rhythm for myself and I'll try to add more content every week. Til next week!

notes.title: Coffee Break Version .3 Update! - Avocado Toast!
notes.content:
Hey guys! Welcome back to another weekly update of Coffee Break! This week I've made a few more content expansions to the game. I admit it wasn't a week with a huge amount of content, but I'm still trying to figure out how to work the game's updates into my workflow, so bear with me. I think I've figured out a way now, and will basically be adding at least one new thing every single day to the game, whether it be a new decoration, new character, new feature, etc.

Overall though the game is getting more and more stable every day, which is my overall goal.

Anyway, onto the updates!

NEW CHARACTER! 

Anthony is now playable in Coffee Break!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/husCCYmxFZdkX5Tn6a/giphy.gif[/img]

This coming week I have a lot of plans for updating Coffee Break. Namely, I want to focus on localization! It shouldn't be too difficult since there's not too much language or dialogue in the game (yet).

Also, Avocado Toast?!

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/h8mBG9vlI2ANxG9Ols/giphy.gif[/img]

I've added all the toast recipes! Including toast, toast with cream cheese, and avocado toast! 

Anyway, I want to thank you guys for playing Coffee Break! If you have any characters that you'd like to see, let me know! Thanks again dudes!

notes.title: Patch Notes 2/5/2020
notes.content: Fixes a couple minor but problematic bugs. Such as bagels showing up even for people that didn't unlock them in the recipe menu.

notes.title: Version 0.2 Live Now!
notes.content:
For this week's expansion, I've added a couple more tweaks and balances, as well as more decorations and characters to play as!

You can now play as a Panda and a Cat character, and unlock them accordingly!

For Decorations, I've added:
[list]
[*] Black Chandelier
[*] A couple more window variations
[*] Arcade Cabinets
[*] A Movie Poster
[*] Some new light variations
[/list]

For recipes, I added bagels! As well as bagels with cream cheese! As such, I've also added an oven so that you can toast the bagels.

I also tweaked a number of things, such as the rate at which the orders come in depending on how many players you are playing as. This way you don't get too overwhelmed when playing solo.



[previewyoutube=RLOUiY0LctI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Early Access Schedule and Weekly Update Plan
notes.content:
Hey guys! So I wanted to discuss my new schedule and plan for Early Access. I've given it some thought and have decided that I will be doing a fixed weekly update schedule for Coffee Break! 


Every Friday I will be: 

[list]
[*] adding new character skins
[*] adding new decorations
[*] adding some kind of feature update
[/list]

... starting next Friday (January 31)

This week was the first week of Coffee Break, and it's been a crazy week for me personally. I fixed every bug I could find and think I now have a nice solid and stable game foundation for which I can start slapping on new updates and expansions.

So I just wanted you all to know that I am super excited to be working on this game and I am super excited to be adding content and features for you guys.

And to all who are playing now, THANK YOU SO MUCH!!!

notes.title: Day 2 Patch!
notes.content:
Hey, guys! So I made a few more tweaks to the game. This first week is going to be FULL OF THEM as I essentially get my bearings and get into the flow of things. I believe now we are finally at the point where the game is properly playable and can be enjoyed without any bugs breaking things.

Bug Fixes: 

[list]
[*] Ice Machine wasn't showing properly after the first patch. Now it's good!
[*] Cabinet contents and milk not transferring over daily. Should be now!
[*] Fixed customer walking speed on high-clock CPUs. Sorry about that madness!
[/list]

Tweaks:

[list]
[*] Tweaked the dynamic ticketing system to occur more slowly and naturally so that drinks to pile up so heavily so quickly. Probably needs additional tweaking so I'm keeping this one on my radar.
[/list]

notes.title: Day One Patch!
notes.content:
Hey guys! I just wanted to let everyone know that based on player feedback I've made the first update for the game! Here's a list of bug fixes and tweaks that I've made so that the core loop is working fine and feels better.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where you pick up cardboard box even when you're holding object.
[*] Fixed bug where price for coffee beans was not matching the actual price deducted
[*] Fixed floating point bug for the money earned at end of the day.
[/list]
[b]Tweaks and Balances:[/b]
[list]
[*] Tweaked milk costs lower so that milk drinks earned a profit.
[*] Tweaked the balancing for the dynamic ticket system so tickets slowly speed up instead of speeding up extremely quickly, which can get very unwieldy, very quickly.
[/list]
I'm going to be making more tweaks over the next week, and hopefully get the bulk of them out of the way so I can start adding the fun part, CONTENT!

New decorations, new characters, and new recipes are just around the corner! Just need to get these first alterations and adjustments made, and we'll be cruising.

I also want to personally thank you guys for playing the game! It means so much that you're playing something I made.

If you have any bugs to report or suggestions for anything, content, or otherwise, please feel free to email me or post them anywhere in the Coffee Break community discussions. Thanks so much, and enjoy!

notes.title: Coffee Break Early Access Launch!!
notes.content:
Hey guys! Super excited to share that Version 0.1 of Coffee Break is now live and playable on Steam!

I did my best to make a playable build that you can play for hours and not get bored! I plan to add WEEKLY UPDATES of the game to Steam so that there can be a consistent flow of games to be played! So yea, SUPER excited that phase 1 is now complete and you can now purchase and play the game, and start your own little cafe!

ENJOY! And I'm looking forward to sharing with you the next update of the game!
